name: aukalo
description: Aukalo: Discord and Telegram bridge for Codex and Claude Code: approval and action alerts, a channel per session, smart delivery, and replies from your phone in Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Claude Code and Codex sessions in Discord and Telegram
interface.longDescription: Sends approval requests and turns blocked on user action to Discord or Telegram, with a channel per session and readable formatting. In Codex the bridge is notification-only. Bot secrets stay in a device-local configuration outside the plugin and repository.
